note: Knob DIFF over the base depth-stack frame. The base owns pin/scrub/snap/signed-depth/reduced-motion; these are the deal-conveyor + fan geometry constants this variant's engine (variant.js) paints with, plus the frame knobs it passes to DepthStack.mount. Byte-faithful to depth-d2-deal-fan.html.

engine.roleA_p: >= 1   (parked deck / hand, fanned up-right with 3D depth)
engine.roleB_in_p: 0 < p < 1   (incoming: descends deck-slot → centre, pure DOWN)
engine.roleB_spent_p: p < 0   (spent: continues DOWN past bottom, z+ toward viewer)
